_comment: Android App Links verification file (plan 171). Fill in the SHA256 signing-cert fingerprint(s) - `keytool -list -v -keystore <keystore> | grep SHA256` - then copy this file to shells/web/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json so it serves at https://lolly.tools/.well-known/assetlinks.json. Until it is published, the manifest's autoVerify filter degrades to the manual 'Open supported links' toggle instead of auto-opening. Add one fingerprint per signing cert (debug + release both work side by side).
